Vendored official npm distribution files (same version):
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.js
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/build/three.core.js

Runtime imports are local. three.module.js imports three.core.js relatively.
No CDN is contacted by the game. Keep THREE-LICENSE.txt when redistributing.
